title: Gold and gold alloys, jewellery/artefacts - Fineness and marking - Specification (Fourth Revision)
scope_description: Specifies fineness grades for hallmarking: originally 14/18/22 carat, later amended to add 20/23/24 carat, and 9 carat (375 grade) added July 2025. This is THE core standard for gold hallmarking.
notes: Confirmed via BIS official site and multiple sources. Mandatory hallmarking effective July 1 2022 in 288 districts (may have expanded since).

title: Assaying of gold in gold bullion, gold alloys and gold jewellery/artefacts - Cupellation (Fire Assay Method)
scope_description: Defines the technical assay method used to determine gold purity at Assaying & Hallmarking Centres.

title: Guidelines for manufacture of 23, 22, 21, 18, 14 and 9 carat gold alloys
scope_description: NOTE: This is a manufacturing guideline for gold alloys, NOT a sampling/marking procedure standard as sometimes assumed - correct this if referenced elsewhere.
notes: IMPORTANT CORRECTION: earlier prototype content incorrectly described IS 2790 as a 'sampling' standard - actual scope is alloy manufacturing guidelines

title: General requirements for establishment and operation of Assaying and Hallmarking (A&H) Centres
scope_description: Basis for BIS recognition of the testing centres that perform hallmarking, not the jewellery itself.
notes: Confirmed via official BIS hallmarking overview page

title: Silver and silver alloys - Fineness and marking (silver hallmarking)
scope_description: Specifies six grades of silver alloys (990, 970, 925, 900, 835, 800) used in silver jewellery/artefacts.
notes: Confirmed via official BIS 'Brief on Hallmarking Scheme' PDF

title: Gold solders for use in manufacture of jewellery
scope_description: Technical standard for solder alloys used in jewellery-making, referenced in hallmarking framework.
notes: Confirmed via search, listed alongside IS 1417/1418/2790
